source.tested_scope: Peer::send_request_with_option_and_subscription and adjacent ClientRequestMetadata/Peer fields at pinned commit

finding: In the pinned ordinary outbound request path, Peer::send_request_with_option_and_subscription reads client_request_metadata.get(); when present it writes protocol_version, client_info, and client_capabilities into request metadata before applying explicit PeerRequestOptions.meta and the progress token. The method does not consult request_metadata_required(), so that AtomicBool does not gate metadata attachment in this exact send path. Combined with the immediately preceding pinned finding for RoleClient::configure_direct_peer, the stored ServerPeerInfo contribution to these attached defaults is limited to protocol_version; client_info and client_capabilities come from local ClientInfo. This still does not prove that configure_direct_peer has run, or that client_request_metadata is populated, before the first ordinary request after a modern discover handshake.
scope_guard: Positive evidence is limited to the pinned service.rs outbound request assembly plus the already role-local pinned configure_direct_peer finding in worker223. No claim is made about handshake call ordering, require_request_metadata activation, authentication, deployed servers, ChatGPT connector exposure, or end-to-end parity.
exact_continuation: Next invocation: preserve CLEAN bootstrap and exact SHA-only authority freeze.
